method_nomenclature:
\begin{tabular}{@{}p{0.30\textwidth}p{\dimexpr0.70\textwidth-2\tabcolsep\relax}@{}}
\toprule
Notation & Meaning \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textit{Abbreviations}} \\
NTFS & Nonlinear time-fractional Schr\"odinger. \\
PINNs; fPINNs & Physics-informed neural networks; fractional PINNs. \\
GO-fPINNs; FL1-fPINN & Gated operator fractional physics-informed neural networks; fast-L1 fractional PINN. \\
DeepONet; FPINN-deeponet & Deep operator network; fractional PINN--DeepONet. \\
SOE; ADI & Sum of exponentials; alternating direction implicit. \\
\addlinespace
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textit{Symbols and indices}} \\
$\psi;\ u,v$ & Complex wave function; real and imaginary components. \\
$\alpha;\ \beta;\ \gamma$ & Fractional order; dispersion coefficient; cubic nonlinear coefficient. \\
$\eta;\ f$ & Potential field; source term. \\
$\boldsymbol\mu;\ \theta$ & Physical-parameter vector; trainable network parameters. \\
$g;\ \mathcal G_\theta^{(g)}$ & Prescribed binary task gate; GO-fPINNs solution mapping. \\
$\tau,\tau_l;\ \sigma$ & Global/stage time steps; shifted-time parameter $\sigma=1-\alpha/2$. \\
$\mathcal D_{\tau,F}^{\alpha}$ & Fast discrete Caputo operator. \\
$N_{\exp};\ H_r^n$ & Number of SOE terms; recursive SOE history variable. \\
$\mathcal R_u,\mathcal R_v$ & Real and imaginary equation residuals. \\
$\mathcal L_F,\mathcal L_I,\mathcal L_B,\mathcal L_D,\mathcal L_G$ & Equation, initial-condition, boundary-condition, observation, and gradient-enhancement losses. \\
$w_F,w_I,w_B,w_D,w_G$ & Weights of the corresponding loss components. \\
$G_l;\ \mathcal A^{(l)}$ & Spatiotemporal grid; active learning space at stage $l$. \\
$\mathcal M_l;\ N_\mu^{(l)}$ & Parameter sample set and its size at stage $l$. \\
$\mathcal U_\eta^{(l)}$ & Potential basis space at stage $l$. \\
$\mathcal J^{(l)};\ \mathcal L_{\rm inter}^{(l)}$ & Total stage objective; inter-stage consistency loss. \\
$\mathcal E_{L_2},\mathcal E_{\rm amp},\mathcal E_{\rm phase},\mathcal E_{\rm MAE}$ & Relative $L_2$ error; amplitude relative $L_2$ error; masked phase mean absolute error (MAE); complex-valued MAE. \\
$l,\ell,n,r$ & Training-stage, network-layer, time-level, and SOE-term indices, respectively. \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
